package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for domain_constants_declared_in_handler_package: Domain enums, statuses, and lifecycle constants that live in handler packages instead of domain-facing packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

const MaxOrderItems = 10
const OrderStatusPending = "pending"
const OrderStatusShipped = "shipped"

func CreateOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.ContentLength > MaxOrderItems {
		http.Error(w, "too many items", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "order created with status %s", OrderStatusPending)
}
